entries.title: Byte-accounted reference generators (PCG64, xoshiro256++, MT19937, ChaCha20, OS entropy)
entries.outcome_summary: Every read passes through RandomSource.read_bytes with a SHA-256 ledger; measured throughput of the pure-Python generators is 29-156 times below the figures claimed in SOURCE_COMPARISON.md.
entries.constraints: ChaCha20, PCG64 and xoshiro256++ are pure Python and slow; OS entropy is not replayable; a digest identifies a stream, it is not an entropy certificate.

entries.title: NumPy PCG64 raw-word stream with exact word accounting (nuclear module)
entries.outcome_summary: Drove the NC1 families of both frozen nuclear verifications with exact consumption checks (D1) holding in every run.
entries.constraints: Healthy generator only; namespaces of frozen studies must not be sampled by tests.

entries.title: Physical pulse source model (Geiger-Mueller) and Von Neumann / XOR-parity conditioners
entries.outcome_summary: Software models only; no physical GM stream has been acquired, so no entropy result exists.
entries.constraints: No recorded physical stream enters these classes yet; any future stream needs its own provenance and no assumed uniformity.

entries.title: Crypto BLUE synthetic weak-seed and physical-placeholder sources
entries.outcome_summary: Used by the BLUE campaigns to supply bounded 8- and 12-bit seed supports whose keys were all recovered by bounded search.
entries.constraints: Synthetic material only; no physical samples provision keys.

entries.title: Native buffered PCG64 bulk source (C via ctypes)
entries.reference: Bit-exact agreement with the reference Stage D generation path
entries.outcome_summary: With the buffered native bundle the full single-worker generation path went from 12.107 s to 8.216 s per run, with 360 timed runs agreeing exactly with the reference.
entries.constraints: Harness refuses every namespace except its benchmark namespace; GCC/x86 only measured; not a Stage D backend; depends on an externally supplied measure.py by hash.

entries.title: Bit-level fault adapter (bias, Markov rho, stuck bit, periodic coupling)
entries.outcome_summary: Available through the v0.18 namespace; rho acts on the emitted bit stream, not on consumed uniforms, and the rho path loops per bit in Python.
entries.constraints: Not used by any frozen v0.18-v0.20 campaign.

entries.title: Phase II channel faults: acceptance-uniform shift and proposal/acceptance coupling
entries.reference: Byte-identical first 2,048 sweeps against the healthy run (pre-onset identity), Controlled_RNG_fault_report.md
entries.outcome_summary: On the refreshed sampler healthy coverage was 487/512 versus 0/512 under acceptance shift and 13/512 under coupling (post-onset window). Only the pre-onset identity is an independent check; the coverage figures are experiment outcomes.
entries.constraints: Implemented only in the standalone Phase II study, not in the package; strong synthetic adapter faults, not PCG64 defects.

entries.title: Word-level faults SHIFT, LAG1, DUP and real GFSR lag pairs (Stage C)
entries.outcome_summary: Stage C ran all four families with I-1 to I-4 passing and a 319/319 independent recount; GFSR including R250 was harmless and quiet in this application.
entries.constraints: Constant severity per cell; channel-specific faults excluded by protocol section 9.

entries.title: Stage D severity ramp profile and word-fault adapter (FaultyWords)
entries.outcome_summary: An independent regeneration reproduced marks, traces, severity and stream hashes bit for bit on eight full-length runs.
entries.constraints: Accepts only single 8-byte reads and is indexed by sweep; the pilot itself has not been run.

entries.title: Crypto BLUE fault injectors (nonce reuse, counter reset, weak seeds, DRBG compromise)
entries.outcome_summary: ECDSA nonce reuse recovered the synthetic P-256 private scalar in 128/128 confirmation cases.
entries.constraints: Synthetic, locally generated material only.

entries.title: Reused-seed provider for parallel workers (finance)
entries.outcome_summary: K workers produce identical paths; the sqrt(K) standard-error deflation is an analytic consequence that no saved experiment measures.
entries.constraints: No experiment; earlier 'severe risk underestimation' wording is unbacked.

entries.title: Harmonic path-integral Monte Carlo through the package API, with exact centroid refresh
entries.outcome_summary: Through the package API the refreshed sampler covered 3846/4096 (0.9390) and local Metropolis 3323/4096 (0.8113), reproducing Phase II.
entries.constraints: One parameter point; default batch sizes under-cover even with refresh (0.8611 at b=32).

entries.title: Standalone NumPy/Numba harmonic PIMC of Phase II
entries.outcome_summary: Exact finite-M reference checks pass. In the frozen confirmation, centroid refresh 964/1024 and IID Gaussian paths 969/1024 met their gates, while local Metropolis (811/1024) failed its coverage and variance-ratio gates on a healthy RNG: a sampler/estimator failure, not an RNG problem (primary_decision.json pass: false).
entries.constraints: 19 NPZ trace archives are off-repo; one workload and one interval method.

entries.title: 2D Ising Metropolis samplers (source-API and vectorised kernels)
entries.reference: Exact enumeration for periodic L in {2,3,4}
entries.outcome_summary: Healthy chains give exact-matching energy but a badly wrong plug-in susceptibility at L4 T1.5 (0.745828 vs exact 10.403227).
entries.constraints: No exact reference above L=4; strong acceptance shift makes magnetised states absorbing.

entries.title: Harmonic variational Monte Carlo
entries.outcome_summary: Demonstrates the known zero-variance property: a proposal-biased chain reports energy 0.5 with zero variance while <x^2> is wrong by 1.656.
entries.constraints: Demonstration of a textbook property, not a hypothesis; earlier README numbers did not reproduce.

entries.title: Nuclear Layer A event-level decay simulator (synthetic schemes)
entries.reference: Analytic decay laws (exponential, Bateman, branching, photon yields)
entries.outcome_summary: Frozen verification at c616a7b: R1 PASS, R2 MET; no Holm rejection in NC1 (47 tests) or NC2 (33 tests); deterministic checks D1-D5 and A1 hold.
entries.constraints: Synthetic schemes, no nuclear data; experimental validation not applicable; RNG-defect sensitivity untested (Phases E/F).

entries.title: Nuclear B2 aggregated (population-level) decay engine
entries.reference: Multinomial law of independent decay; frozen Layer A engine
entries.outcome_summary: Frozen verification: R1 PASS, R2 MET, C1 holds for both families (null false-FAIL 0.0088 NC1, 0.0080 NC2); populations up to 2^60+12,345 conserved.
entries.constraints: Open: BT-NEUTRON NC1 tail at 2.52x the union bound in calibration; Xc-400m variance observation unresolved; synthetic schemes only.

entries.title: Finance proof of concept: European option, portfolio VaR, expected shortfall
entries.outcome_summary: Models and reference agree in unit tests; no saved experiment exists.
entries.constraints: Regulatory framing (SR 11-7, TRIM, Basel III) withdrawn as unbacked.

entries.title: Crypto BLUE conditioning, AEAD, signature and DRBG pipeline
entries.reference: RFC known-answer tests for RFC6979 and Ed25519
entries.outcome_summary: A known 8-bit seed through conditioner and expander yields streams that mostly pass three diagnostics yet are predicted exactly in 128/128 replicas.
entries.constraints: Three diagnostics, not the full SP 800-22 battery; synthetic data only.

entries.title: Decision-support model (v0.14)
entries.outcome_summary: Exposed by the Laboratory GUI adapter; no frozen study uses it.
entries.constraints: No dedicated test file found.

entries.title: Monte Carlo pi estimator (teaching workload)
entries.outcome_summary: Toy workload with an exact target; used by the Laboratory GUI.
entries.constraints: Not part of any frozen study.

entries.title: Detector waveform export inspector and ceiling check
entries.outcome_summary: Re-derived from the raw export: 117,962 records, 108,473 (91.96%) reach the 16-bit ceiling and every timestamp is a multiple of 80.
entries.constraints: Raw export is off-repo; particle identity and entropy per sample not established.

entries.title: Physical acquisition suite (acquire, ingest, integrity, NIST checks) with Arduino firmware
entries.outcome_summary: Pipeline is tested on fixtures; no physical stream has been assessed for entropy.
entries.constraints: Sensor streams have no validated entropy; hardware use needs technician-approved interfaces.

entries.title: Geiger-Mueller event acquisition
entries.outcome_summary: A plan for instrument metadata and raw capture; no GM data exist in the repository.
entries.constraints: Event output availability unconfirmed.

entries.title: SP 800-90B min-entropy evaluation of a physical stream
entries.outcome_summary: Earlier README claim withdrawn: estimators exist but no 90B assessment of any physical stream was run.
entries.constraints: Capability exists in code; no result.

entries.title: SP 800-22 subset in rnglab14 standards (monobit, block frequency, runs)
entries.outcome_summary: Implements three tests; the 'all 15 pass' claim in SOURCE_COMPARISON.md is impossible with this code.
entries.constraints: Three tests only.

entries.title: Stage C conventional battery: seven SP 800-22 tests plus lag-1 correlation and identical adjacent words
entries.outcome_summary: Calibrated to a whole-run false-alarm rate 0.048584 (gate V2) and alarmed after onset in every run of all 18 synthetic cells.
entries.constraints: For LAG1 the early detection depended on the targeted lag-1 test (Sensitivity 01).

entries.title: Application-arm monitors: TD-CV estimator invariant and uphill-proposal fraction
entries.outcome_summary: The application arm never alarmed alone in a synthetic cell and, when both alarmed, was later by a median of 512 to 5,376 sweeps; H1-C not supported.
entries.constraints: Matched false alarms (0.0424805); harmonic PIMC only.

entries.title: SP 800-90B repetition-count and adaptive-proportion health tests
entries.outcome_summary: In Stage C the health tests alone stayed near their healthy rate for LAG1, and for DUP up to severity 0.19.
entries.constraints: No field result on a physical stream.

entries.title: SP 800-90B entropy estimators
entries.outcome_summary: Capability only; never applied to a physical stream.
entries.constraints: No physical evaluation.

entries.title: Frozen rank calibration of whole-trajectory monitor scores
entries.outcome_summary: Used for the v0.17 whole-path calibration whose H1 false-alarm ceiling failed jointly (10/12 cells).
entries.constraints: Exchangeability assumption.

entries.title: v0.14 dual integrity monitor ('0.0% hazardous gap')
entries.outcome_summary: The 0.0% hazardous-gap result came from one uncalibrated run of 100 snapshots and is contradicted by Phase II monitor blind spots.
entries.constraints: Do not cite.

entries.title: Phase II monitors: marginal source mean, joint channel, application shape
entries.outcome_summary: The marginal source check missed coupling, the joint check detected it, and the application-shape monitor missed the acceptance shift; no general ranking follows.
entries.constraints: Coupling is invisible to single-stream tests by construction.

entries.title: Crypto BLUE source health monitor with frozen healthy calibration
entries.outcome_summary: The frozen healthy false-alarm criterion (<= 0.10) was not met: CP95 upper bound 0.1194 (8/128 healthy alarms).
entries.constraints: Alarms during downstream nonce faults are alarms on an unchanged source, not detections.

entries.title: Native C/AVX2 measurement kernels (pattern histogram, cumulative max, longest run)
entries.outcome_summary: Kernel speed-ups of 5.68x to 17.57x for the battery statistics with exact output agreement.
entries.constraints: Only two functions use explicit intrinsics; not installed into Stage D.

entries.title: Exact finite-bead harmonic PIMC energy and Gaussian path sampler
entries.outcome_summary: Phase II's independent reference calculations found no finite-M target or energy-formula explanation for the undercoverage.
entries.constraints: m = hbar = omega = 1 units.

entries.title: Exact finite-lattice Ising enumeration (L <= 4)
entries.outcome_summary: Provides exact susceptibility 10.403227 at L4 T1.5; the earlier claim of L=8 exact validation is unbacked.
entries.constraints: Raises for L > 4.

entries.title: Analytic result: acceptance shift delta >= exp(-8/T) makes magnetised Ising states absorbing
entries.outcome_summary: Analytically backed; the numerical illustration's outputs are off-repo.
entries.constraints: Numbers partially backed only.

entries.title: Nuclear analytic references: Bateman path sums, decimal interval laws, matrix exponential
entries.outcome_summary: Decimal laws agree with two matrix exponentials within 1.57e-13 over 113 interval laws (D8); Layer A route difference 5.33e-15.
entries.constraints: Adaptive decimal precision, not certified interval arithmetic.

entries.title: AR(1) exact finite-n long-run variance reference
entries.outcome_summary: Served as exact target for the 4,096-replica long-run variance campaign with 28/28 recount agreement.
entries.constraints: Idealised AR(1).

entries.title: Stage D oracle probability via the frozen noncentral-t call (F-01)
entries.outcome_summary: The frozen scipy call is non-finite at 1,554 of 12,001 grid points between delta 8.53 and 43.61; resolution documented, awaiting the author's amendment decision.
entries.constraints: Cannot change a stop criterion per readiness report; oracle only.

entries.title: Black-Scholes closed-form reference
entries.outcome_summary: Unit-tested reference for the option model.
entries.constraints: No experiment.

entries.title: Long-run variance estimators: BM, OBM, SV-B, SV-TH, Geyer
entries.outcome_summary: Calibrated for tau <= 19 in 15/15 gates (H-L supported); BM(32) covers only 0.547 at tau ~ 199.
entries.constraints: Spectral estimators run 6-8% low at b/n=1/16; at long tau only Geyer stays near nominal.

entries.title: Batch-length diagnostic that abstains on short runs
entries.outcome_summary: Mixed, recorded as a negative result for its intended use: on AR(1) the frozen H-D gates were supported, but on the refreshed PIMC sampler it accepted every run while covering only 0.8828, and the v0.18 API-validation report says it must not be used for that sampler.
entries.constraints: AR(1)-derived 10*tau rule misses slow shape modes of the PIMC path; not usable as an adequacy check for the refreshed PIMC sampler.

entries.title: Symmetry-aware Ising susceptibility estimator S
entries.outcome_summary: Calibrated in all 9 cells (coverage 0.925-0.949, bias within +-0.0007).
entries.constraints: Relies on exact zero-field spin-flip symmetry; T=1.5 coverage near lower gate edge.

entries.title: Generic 16-chain jackknife susceptibility G
entries.outcome_summary: Unbiased but its interval fails in 5 of 9 cells (coverage 0.836-0.916 at T=1.5), so H-S is not supported.
entries.constraints: No generic repair established.

entries.title: Within-chain plug-in susceptibility P
entries.outcome_summary: Healthy-chain failure replicated: relative bias -0.917 at L4 T1.5 (v0.17: 0.745828 against exact 10.403227).
entries.constraints: Estimator and mixing failure with healthy random numbers, not an RNG defect.

entries.title: Rank-normalised split-R-hat convergence diagnostic
entries.outcome_summary: Flagged the sign non-mixing behind P's failure in 2,048 of 2,048 ensembles at L4 T1.5 (gate D-F1).
entries.constraints: Bulk version only, no folded variant.

entries.title: Short batch-means intervals for PIMC energy (package defaults b=32, b=128)
entries.outcome_summary: Under-cover even with the centroid refresh: 0.8611 at b=32 and 0.9260 at b=128; v0.17 short-block analyses gave 172/512 (BM32) and 311/512 (BM128).
entries.constraints: Use BM512 with 16 batches for this workload.

entries.title: Conditional forecasting components (declared-family forecasters, scoring, validity)
entries.outcome_summary: On the surrogate under the declared ramp the declared-model forecaster had Brier skill 0.228 [0.189, 0.268]; outside the family skill was -0.256 and -0.218.
entries.constraints: Surrogate workload only; not a test of H2 or of any generator.

entries.title: Stage D pilot forecasters F0, F0+, F-B-lite, F-AB-lite and evaluation barrier
entries.outcome_summary: Implemented and tested on synthetic fixtures; agrees with the independent recount on 1,972 of 1,974 fields; never fitted on real pilot data.
entries.constraints: Known-family laboratory design; pilot gated on author decisions C-3 to C-12.

entries.title: v0.16 TRIDENT theory-informed failure forecaster
entries.outcome_summary: Theory Brier 0.08869430 vs combined 0.08867247 on test (required improvement 0.02 not reached) and worse out of distribution; the endpoint confounded thermal fluctuation with reliability loss.
entries.constraints: Outputs off-repo.

entries.title: v0.17 CALIBRATE failure-risk boundaries and forecasts (H1-H5)
entries.outcome_summary: H1 failed jointly (10/12 cells), H4 full usefulness and H5 unseen-fault generalisation unsupported; only H2 supported in seven selected cells.
entries.constraints: Outputs off-repo.

entries.title: Forecast baselines and survival scoring (no-change, linear extrapolation, Kaplan-Meier, IPCW Brier)
entries.outcome_summary: Building blocks with unit tests; no frozen study validates them.
entries.constraints: Unvalidated as forecasters.

entries.title: Remaining-useful-sample non-identifiability counterexample
entries.outcome_summary: Two degradation processes with identical observed history have different futures, so unrestricted forecasting needs a declared continuation; the excess-Brier bound is 0.2488 in this construction.
entries.constraints: A constructive counterexample, not a formal proof of the general theorem.

entries.title: v0.14 recovery and forecast validation experiments
entries.outcome_summary: Scripts and tests exist; no saved output in the repository records their results.
entries.constraints: No frozen protocol; outputs not in Git.

entries.title: Phase I scalar PIMC uncertainty pilot (2026-10-30)
entries.outcome_summary: Historical pilot whose coverage counts Phase II verified; it was not evidence of RNG-induced failure.
entries.constraints: Use Phase II instead.

entries.title: Phase II harmonic PIMC confirmation (local, refresh, IID)
entries.outcome_summary: Healthy local Metropolis under-covers (811/1024) while centroid refresh (964/1024) and IID control (969/1024) pass the frozen gates: a sampler failure, not an RNG problem.
entries.constraints: NPZ traces off-repo.

entries.title: Phase II controlled random-channel fault study
entries.outcome_summary: Paired 512-replica study: 487/512 healthy coverage versus 0/512 (acceptance shift) and 13/512 (coupling).
entries.constraints: Two strong synthetic faults; no general monitor ranking.

entries.title: Phase II exact stationary dependence control
entries.outcome_summary: Reproduced short-batch variance underestimation with a correct target and healthy random inputs.
entries.constraints: Control study, not an RNG result.

entries.title: v0.16 TRIDENT cross-model and forecasting study
entries.outcome_summary: Theory features gave no Brier improvement and the forecasting endpoint confounded thermal fluctuation with reliability loss; 18/24 paired Ising contrasts passed Holm.
entries.constraints: Outputs off-repo (~/ evidence root); an accidental same-seed replay is excluded.

entries.title: v0.17 CALIBRATE study (H1-H5)
entries.outcome_summary: H1 partial with global criterion failed, H2 supported in seven selected cells, H3 partial, H4 and H5 unsupported; healthy PIMC still under-covers.
entries.constraints: Outputs off-repo; intervention benefit never measured.

entries.title: v0.18 Phase 1 estimator repair
entries.outcome_summary: Mixed: H-L and H-D supported, H-S not supported (jackknife fails 5/9 cells), and the frozen control verdict was FALSE (1 of 20 intervals missed; controls_valid false in results/gates.json), documented in Amendment 01. Recorded as negative-result because not all frozen gates passed; the taxonomy has no 'mixed' label.
entries.constraints: Instrument checks on small lattices and idealised AR(1).

entries.title: v0.18 Phase 2 Phase II core result through the package API
entries.outcome_summary: H-API and H-REP supported: refresh 3846/4096, IID 3884/4096, local 3323/4096; paired improvement 0.1277 [0.1138, 0.1414]; recount 21/21.
entries.constraints: Small unexplained refresh bias (CV -0.000321) inside the gate.

entries.title: v0.18 Stage C application-aware detection at matched false alarms (H1)
entries.outcome_summary: H1-C not supported in any of SHIFT, LAG1, DUP, GFSR: no H1 cell and no undetected-harm cell among 24, with all validity gates passing and recount 319/319.
entries.constraints: Channel-specific faults excluded; one application.

entries.title: v0.18 Stage C Sensitivity 01: battery without the targeted word tests
entries.outcome_summary: With only seven SP 800-22 tests the Stage C verdicts stand, but for LAG1 up to 186/256 runs were wrong with no alarm and LAG1-4 missed the H1 class only by its lower bound (0.496 vs 0.5).
entries.constraints: Post hoc on stored Stage C data; plan frozen at c7231fa before analysis.

entries.title: Crypto BLUE reviewed confirmation campaign (128 replicas)
entries.outcome_summary: Seed-space weakness and nonce misuse were demonstrated, but the healthy-alarm bound failed (8/128) and SHA256/ChaCha20 missed the preregistered 90% non-rejection criterion (adjusted p=0.0509588).
entries.constraints: Synthetic; does not establish general security-failure prediction. Hash list in manifest.json, no protocol.sha256.

entries.title: Crypto BLUE reviewed sensitivity campaign (64 replicas, longer horizon)
entries.outcome_summary: Non-rejection 63/64, 63/64, 64/64 and 64/64 met its four-cell criteria; it does not change the confirmation decision.
entries.constraints: Same synthetic scope as confirmation. Non-rejection does not establish security; no production key-generation assurance.

entries.title: v0.19 Stage D feasibility pilot (H2-R)
entries.outcome_summary: Protocol frozen 2026-11-10 and the execution path implemented; no pilot, smoke or campaign run generated; readiness assessment CONDITIONAL GO for the smoke first.
entries.constraints: Generation refused without the author's authorization.json; F-01 oracle decision and storage (~31 GiB) pending.

entries.title: Stage D smoke run (ten runs, own namespace)
entries.outcome_summary: Pre-generation manifest committed for the author's review; no smoke run exists.
entries.constraints: Excluded from every result by design.

entries.title: v0.19 forecasting methods validation on a surrogate workload
entries.outcome_summary: Readings R1, R2, R3 and R7 MET (R4-R6 descriptive); forecasters fail outside the declared family.
entries.constraints: Not a test of H2-R or of any generator.

entries.title: Independent recount, replay, verifier, integrity scan and preflight (v0.19 audit)
entries.outcome_summary: Reproduces Stage C independently (threshold 3.8177723774232715, 199/4096 alarms, 3867/4096 coverage) and never imports the primary pilot code.
entries.constraints: Organisationally the same project, not an external audit.

entries.title: v0.20 nuclear Layer A frozen verification
entries.outcome_summary: R1 PASS, R2 MET; run once at c616a7b on a clean tree.
entries.constraints: Synthetic schemes.

entries.title: v0.20 nuclear B2 frozen calibration and verification
entries.reference: Multinomial independent-decay law; Layer A engine
entries.outcome_summary: R1 PASS, R2 MET, C1 holds; open questions on the BT-NEUTRON NC1 calibration tail and the Xc-400m variance observation.
entries.constraints: Synthetic schemes.

entries.title: v0.20 nuclear B2 numerical limits
entries.outcome_summary: Binomial distribution function error at most 3.2e-16 as the sampler consults it (n 10 to 1e9); no non-finite Boost values up to the 2^50 part limit.
entries.constraints: Measurement, not a hypothesis test.

entries.title: v0.20 nuclear B2 single-machine benchmark
entries.outcome_summary: Single-workstation timings recorded with git_dirty true and the machine in ordinary use; not HPC measurements.
entries.constraints: System load not recorded.

entries.title: Nuclear Layer B (branching, reduced kinetics), Layer C (detector response), Phases E-G (RNG defects, criticality, HPC)
entries.outcome_summary: Not started; next step is Phase C (Layer B) with its own frozen verification in a fresh namespace.
entries.constraints: Nothing measured on an HPC system.

entries.title: Stage E intervention and lifetime extension (H3)
entries.outcome_summary: Never measured; stays conditional on the Stage D pilot; v0.17 used only a hypothetical 50% mitigation.
entries.constraints: No mid-run source switch or checkpoint branching in the package.

entries.title: v0.14 integrated experiment and experiment registry
entries.outcome_summary: One uncalibrated run; 'replicated over 10 seeds' and the 0.0% hazardous gap are not supported by the saved results.
entries.constraints: Do not cite.

entries.title: Source comparison benchmark matrix
entries.outcome_summary: No producing script; throughputs 29-156x above measured for four of five sources and an impossible 'all 15' SP 800-22 claim.
entries.constraints: Not marked superseded in the file itself.

entries.title: CPU versus GPU (L4) benchmarks
entries.outcome_summary: No benchmark script, raw timing or telemetry in Git (0 of 67 numbers matched any repository output).
entries.constraints: Author's own measurements, not reproducible from the repository.

entries.title: Legacy packages rnglab v0.2-v0.8 and rnglab10-rnglab13 (historical snapshots)
entries.outcome_summary: Kept unchanged for traceability; the v0.18 namespace re-exports only audited components from rnglab12/14/16/17.
entries.constraints: rnglab12.uncertainty and rnglab13.math remain in use.

entries.title: Laboratory GUI: local server, model catalog, worker adapters, historical archive browser
entries.outcome_summary: Imported from the lab-gui worktree (5de3f30), then changed on this branch: verification, capacity and reader fixes, four adapters reworded, unified screens added. Adapters exist for PIMC, Ising, pi, decision support, H1 detection and both nuclear engines.
entries.constraints: Not reachable from e690488. Software checks only: running a model changes no scientific status.

entries.title: Control-center C++ artefact/journal/NPZ reader prototype
entries.outcome_summary: About 1,400 lines of untracked C++ readers for artefacts, the audit journal and NPZ traces; never committed.
entries.constraints: Exists only as untracked files in one worktree; at risk of loss.

entries.title: Study figure and table scripts (Phase II plots, Stage C figures, report_tables.py per study)
entries.outcome_summary: Each frozen study writes its tables and figures from its result JSON.
entries.constraints: Static outputs only.

entries.title: Shared source registry and recorded-stream replay source
entries.outcome_summary: One registry over the rnglab14 sources and the NumPy PCG64 source, with separate fields for determinism, statistical quality, entropy claim, unpredictability and independence; recorded files replay from disjoint, digest-checked segments.

entries.title: Shared fault registry with compatibility contracts
entries.outcome_summary: Byte, bit and word faults are reused unchanged (registry bytes equal direct construction); contracts refuse word faults on non-aligned roles and model-internal families.

entries.title: Shared model adapters (PIMC, VMC, Ising, nuclear Layer A and B2)
entries.outcome_summary: Adapters call the canonical model code unchanged; the PIMC adapter reproduces three frozen golden cases bit for bit and the word splitter leaves both nuclear digests unchanged.

entries.title: Shared measurement layer (reference deviation, interval failure, paired effects, Holm, battery)
entries.outcome_summary: Reuses rnglab14 Holm, rnglab17 exact rates and the frozen Stage C battery.
entries.constraints: The battery rule (Holm over ten tests) is not the frozen study's calibrated threshold; paired p-values use a normal approximation.

entries.title: Experiment specification, engine, sealed records and replay
entries.outcome_summary: One spec runs matched healthy, faulted and (optionally) intervened arms across models into one sealed record; replay reproduces spec, stream and result digests.
entries.constraints: Single-machine replay only; no frozen-protocol mode yet.

entries.title: Online monitor, authorised source switch and conditional exposure forecast
entries.outcome_summary: Detection-triggered switch to an independent source with measured recovery; exposure forecast under a declared persistent-step model, checked against the faulted arm.
entries.constraints: Monitor not calibrated at matched false alarms; the rnglab.prognosis forecasters are not connected; no frozen study.

entries.title: Cross-domain SHIFT exploration (interactive runs)
entries.outcome_summary: Interactive runs only (small replicate counts, no frozen protocol): no finding is claimed.
entries.constraints: Must be pre-registered and frozen before any number is reported.

entries.title: Detector-response model connected to physical-event simulations
entries.outcome_summary: Not implemented.
entries.constraints: Needs its own validation before any comparison with simulated events.
